name: roadcraft-workflow
description: Shared RoadCraft instructions for creating and modifying mods, with project setup, authoring checks, pinned builds, package transactions and reusable findings.

interface.shortDescription: Create, modify and validate RoadCraft mods.
interface.longDescription: General mod lifecycle and specialized vehicle-authoring guidance backed by the shared modding library. This skills-only scaffold does not install servers, authoring tools or game assets.
interface.defaultPrompt: Use the RoadCraft workflow to create or modify this mod, select its own project context, reuse applicable findings and validate the requested changes.
